policy.primary_boundary: Resident START through safe RETURN_CPU and token copy. Includes empty-cache prefill and required metadata, transfers, numerical work and output delivery. Excludes provisioning and independent result checks, both separately retained.
policy.checks: Original full-model prompts; exact generated IDs, complete final logits and valid KV, five original selected prefill traces for story, overflow rejection/non-mutation then successful recovery; normal safe cleanup.
policy.scope: Short physical correctness and resident request performance, not a 1024 endurance or tail-latency claim. Fixed-context warmup plus three measured decode samples are a separate campaign.

probes.cleanup: safe return, mappings and file closed

policy.candidate: Signed symmetric W4 [-7,7], RNE, per-output-channel absmax/7 on the original float weights after the accepted train-only smoothing (alpha=0.5). A8 dynamic activation bridge and all int16 storage/KV and M3 arithmetic unchanged. Embeddings/positions stay int16; only 49 GEMM matrices change.
policy.packing: Two signed two's-complement nibbles per byte, even element in low nibble. Host integer GEMM uses unpacked values for quality only, never reported as packed-board performance.
policy.selection: One candidate; no group-size, clipping, calibration or alpha sweep. First 64 predictions of each of the first two pre-existing validation windows. This is a small development screen, not untouched held-out qualification or a full perplexity benchmark.
policy.comparison: Evaluate both accepted W8A8 and candidate W4A8 on identical teacher-forced prefixes against independent FloatGPT2. Report all metrics, even when the small W8 subset misses a historical aggregate threshold. No criteria relaxation after results.
policy.adoption: A failed screen rejects this candidate. A passing screen is not board adoption: packed decode, changed scale arithmetic, full quality qualification and net system benefit would still be required. W4A4 is deferred if W4A8 fails or current data movement cannot materially improve total latency.

precision.limitations: 128 development predictions, one quantizer; does not rule out all W4 schemes. Packing verified on host, no packed hardware or board-speed result.

limitations: See docs/M5_OPTIMIZATION_RESULTS.md: small fixed-context samples and 2/1/1 complete requests, no new 1024 endurance, FPGA rebuild, packed W4 performance or M6.
